# Caption styles

14 caption presets. Captions are generated from asset transcripts and stay in sync through every edit.

```json
"captions": { "style": "bold-pop", "overrides": { "highlightColor": "#00FF88", "position": 0.65 } }
```

**Modes:** `static` shows the whole phrase, `highlight` colors the spoken word, `karaoke` sweeps color across words, `word` shows one word at a time, and `reveal` shows words as they are spoken. Font sizes assume a 1080px short side and scale with resolution.

## Presets

| id | Name | Mode | Font | Size | Upper | Colors (text / highlight) | Box | Animation | Words/line | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `classic` | Classic Subtitles | static | Arial | 52 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | none | 8 | Clean white subtitles with a thin outline at the bottom. Works everywhere (YouTube, interviews, docs). |
| `bold-pop` | Bold Pop (Hormozi style) | highlight | Arial Black | 82 | yes | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | pop | 3 | Big uppercase heavy words, thick outline, spoken word highlighted in yellow and scaled up. The viral short-form look. |
| `green-highlight` | Green Highlight | highlight | Arial Black | 76 | yes | #FFFFFF / #39FF14 |  | pop | 3 | Uppercase captions where the active word turns bright green. High-energy social style. |
| `karaoke` | Karaoke Sweep | karaoke | Arial | 68 |  | #FFFFFF / #00D1FF |  | none | 5 | Color fills each word as it is spoken. Great for music, lyrics and tutorials. |
| `word-by-word` | Word by Word | word | Impact | 120 | yes | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | pop | 1 | One big word at a time in the center of the screen. Punchy, fast-paced, retention-focused. |
| `reveal` | Progressive Reveal | reveal | Arial | 70 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | none | 4 | Words appear one by one as they are spoken while the phrase builds up. |
| `boxed` | Boxed | static | Arial | 58 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 | #000000CC | none | 6 | Text on a solid dark box. Highly legible over busy footage; news/explainer feel. |
| `boxed-highlight` | Boxed Highlight | highlight | Arial | 60 |  | #111111 / #6C47FF | #FFFFFFF2 | none | 5 | White box with black text and the active word in brand color. Clean, modern, LinkedIn-friendly. |
| `minimal` | Minimal | static | Arial | 46 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | none | 7 | Small, light, lowercase-friendly captions with a soft shadow. Aesthetic vlogs and lifestyle. |
| `neon` | Neon Glow | highlight | Arial | 72 | yes | #E0FFFF / #00FFFF |  | fade | 3 | Bright cyan text with a glowing magenta outline. Gaming, nightlife, tech. |
| `cinematic` | Cinematic | static | Georgia | 46 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFE600 |  | fade | 9 | Elegant serif italics, small and low. Documentaries, film, storytelling. |
| `comic` | Comic | highlight | Comic Sans MS | 78 |  | #FFE600 / #FF3B30 |  | pop | 3 | Chunky yellow text with heavy black outline. Memes, comedy, kids content. |
| `subtle-highlight` | Subtle Highlight | highlight | Arial | 60 |  | #FFFFFF / #FFD54A |  | none | 5 | Sentence-case captions with the active word in soft yellow. Professional talking heads and courses. |
| `typewriter` | Typewriter Mono | reveal | Courier New | 56 |  | #00FF88 / #FFE600 | #000000DD | none | 5 | Monospace words revealed as spoken on a dark box. Tech, coding, hacker aesthetic. |

## Overridable fields

Any of these can go in `captions.overrides`:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | "static" \| "highlight" \| "karaoke" \| "word" \| "reveal" |  | `"static"` | static = whole phrase; highlight = phrase with the spoken word colored; karaoke = color sweeps across words; word = one word at a time; reveal = words appear as spoken |
| `fontFamily` | string |  | `"Arial"` |  |
| `fontSize` | number |  | `64` | (> 0) |
| `bold` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `italic` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `color` | string |  | `"#FFFFFF"` |  |
| `highlightColor` | string |  | `"#FFE600"` |  |
| `outlineColor` | string |  | `"#000000"` |  |
| `outlineWidth` | number |  | `4` | (≥ 0) |
| `shadow` | number |  | `0` | (≥ 0) |
| `shadowColor` | string |  | `"#00000099"` |  |
| `background` | string |  |  | Box color behind captions |
| `highlightScale` | number |  | `1` | (≥ 1, ≤ 2) |
| `animation` | "none" \| "pop" \| "fade" \| "slide-up" \| "zoom" |  | `"none"` |  |
| `position` | number |  | `0.78` | (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `maxWordsPerLine` | integer |  | `4` | (> 0) |
| `maxCharsPerLine` | integer |  | `24` | (> 0) |
| `maxLines` | integer |  | `2` | (> 0) |
| `maxDuration` | number |  | `3` | (> 0) |
| `letterSpacing` | number |  | `0` |  |
